name: Punctura
tagline: Enterprise-grade scheduling infrastructure for the modern tattoo practice.
positioning: Punctura is the operational system of record for tattoo studios — consultations, deposits, consent, and calendar, unified into one compliant workflow.

hero.h1: The booking system of record for serious tattoo studios.
hero.sub: Punctura consolidates consultations, deposits, consent forms, and artist calendars into one auditable workflow — so your front desk runs like an operations department.

features.title: Deposit-backed booking
features.description: Require, capture, and reconcile deposits at the moment a slot is reserved. No-shows drop when money is on the appointment.

features.title: Digital consent ledger
features.description: Age verification, medical disclosure, and aftercare consent captured per session and archived as immutable, timestamped records.

features.title: Artist calendar control
features.description: Per-artist availability, buffer blocks, and multi-session projects synced across web, staff, and client-facing views.

features.title: Flash & reference intake
features.description: Clients submit references, placement, and sizing before the consult — routed to the assigned artist as a structured brief.

features.title: Revenue reporting
features.description: Track utilization, deposit conversion, and revenue per chair across your studio with exportable monthly statements.

features.title: Automated reminders
features.description: Configurable SMS and email sequences for confirmations, aftercare, and touch-up windows — sent without staff intervention.

testimonials.quote: We cut no-shows by 40% in one quarter. The deposit ledger alone paid for the platform. Our front desk finally stopped living inside a paper calendar.
testimonials.name: Marisol Vega

testimonials.quote: Consent and age verification used to be a compliance liability. Punctura made every session auditable, and our insurer took notice.
testimonials.name: Dominic Hale

testimonials.quote: Managing six artists across two locations was chaos. Now availability, buffers, and multi-session projects live in one system. It runs itself.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman
